thread:
elaine (CEO): quick weekly -- thanks for another strong sprint. three focused asks this week: 1) tighten our production golden signals (p99, error budget burn, KV cache hit) and publish the dashboard, 2) finish the model-catalog lockdown to ensure vetted variants only in Dedicated rollouts, 3) security hardening checklist for private deployments. short notes below. :memo:

harper (VP Eng): noted. runtime will produce the p99 tail analysis and an action list by Wed EOD. we'll add a small dashboard panel for KV hit-rate and avg batch size.

diego (VP Product): product will block any Dedicated region flip unless the catalog policy is enforced and fallback variants are listed. i'll post the enforced catalog PR and naming conventions to #eng-runtime by Tuesday.

renee (Head of Security): security asks: 1) require MFA for all private control-plane users (rolling enforcement next week), 2) run a drift check on customer VPC templates before approving private deploys, 3) add a compliance checkbox to the go-live checklist. compliance has prelim ok on the shorter debug retention plan if audit logs remain at 365d.

elainE (CEO): (note: typo correction) elaine here  please also include a short runbook for suspected key-exposure events.

kim (Head of People): hiring update: two senior infra candidates in loop, expect offers this week. reminder: refer before Friday for the referral bonus window.

ops-bot: incident summary 2001998002 -- earlier today ~18m elevated latencies for chat due to a cache invalidation bug during a cross-region sync. impact limited thanks to fallback routing. mitigation: rollback + increase cache TTL for sync window. RCA link: https://internal.redwood/incident/2001998002

harper (VP Eng): root cause: cross-region sync job sent an unexpected tombstone that evicted hot keys. quick fix merged:```diff
- sync.send(tombstones)
+ sync.send(filter(tombstones))
```

elainE (CEO): (again correcting name) thanks for fast action. two asks: 1) one-page RCA into incidents channel by tomorrow noon, 2) eng-infra to add a CI smoke that simulates cross-region key churn.

diego (VP Product): launch note: APAC Dedicated soft-open still on schedule but marketing holds until p99 and catalog gates are green. sales notified.

harper (VP Eng): deploy-bot shows canary for `dedicated-apac` in progress (build 2025.10.14-03). we'll pause promotion until canary meets p99 window and fallback triggers are exercised.

renee (Head of Security): scheduling a 30m security breakout on Thursday to review private-control-plane checklist and MFA rollout timeline.

elainE (CEO): last bits: finance to publish a short cost-sensitivity slide for exec review (tokens vs. reserved capacity). small ask to all: focus this week on measurable wins (p99 down, catalog locked, MFA live). Friday 9:30am PT short sync to review metrics. thanks everyone. :sparkles:
